stanza: a cramped dressmaker's workroom in a poor house of a remote mountain village, present day, afternoon: plain walls painted a pale green, with a few damp stains; in the middle a big wooden worktable covered with dark cloth, with an old black cast-iron sewing machine with faded gold lettering, a pair of big scissors and a red pincushion on it; on the left two identical tailor's dummies stand side by side, each wearing the same unfinished black men's funeral jacket with white basting threads; on the right a wooden chair with a tall pile of folded white bed sheets, the top one printed with a small blue triangle logo; rolls of fabric lean in the corner; at the back a small window with a lace curtain. A bare light bulb hanging from the ceiling gives even light.
persone: Two identical twin sisters in their mid thirties sit side by side behind the worktable, facing the viewer, in exactly the same pose, like mirror images, their hands folded on the table. They are perfectly identical: very pale porcelain skin, platinum blond, almost white hair cut in the same severe chin-length bob with a blunt straight fringe, nearly invisible white eyebrows and eyelashes, large pale grey eyes set a little too far apart, small upturned noses, small closed mouths and long thin necks; they wear the same mustard-yellow knitted cardigan buttoned up to the neck over a white blouse with a round collar. The only differences: the sister on the left has a small dark mole just under her left eye; the sister on the right has a thick layer of pale face powder on her cheeks, and under it her skin is flushed and her temples shine with sweat. They stare at the viewer together, without blinking.
pose: the two identical sisters sitting side by side behind the worktable with their hands folded on it
oggetti: the worktable with the black sewing machine, the scissors and the pincushion, the two identical tailor's dummies with the black jackets, the chair with the pile of white sheets, the rolls of fabric, the small window with the lace curtain and the bare bulb
muri: smooth plaster painted a pale, faded green, with a few faint damp stains, and a plain white ceiling
tratti: strange, doll-like caricatures rather than sick ones: two perfectly identical faces with heads a little too big and too round, eyes too big and set too far apart, tiny noses, tiny closed mouths, very long thin necks and long thin fingers; no smiles, no grins, no visible teeth, serious and unblinking; unsettling and sinister, but healthy and well fed, with full cheeks and clean skin: never sick, wasted, dirty or dying, never cute or cartoonish
tratti_foto: the same two perfectly identical doll-like faces, the same heads a little too big and round, the same too big, too far apart pale eyes, the same tiny noses and closed mouths, the same long thin necks and fingers, with smooth healthy skin; the mole under the left eye of the sister on the left, and the powder over the flushed, sweaty skin of the sister on the right (the hatching of the drawing is shading, not wrinkles)
